authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6152 danta explicitly gives Maiya/Palula dān, Gawri dant and northwestern dand “tooth”; its addendum includes aspirated Sindhi dandh. The simple dān/dant/dandh survey forms therefore fit this family. Reviewed comparison: Buksa dand “teeth” (f_jxv5klhb2nns6). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.
